item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President ceremonially proclaims a commemorative week; the segment does not govern agencies or alter legal rights, duties, or status.","evidence":"do hereby proclaim the week of September 18–24, 1994,"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President completes the ceremonial designation and makes a nonbinding appeal to agencies and private organizations to promote farm-safety programs, without mandating agency action or legal consequences.","evidence":"I call upon the agencies, organizations, and businesses that serve America's agricultural workers to strengthen their commitment"},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"The President makes a hortatory appeal to citizens to reflect and prioritize agricultural-worker safety; no governmental or legal action is required.","evidence":"I further call upon all citizens of our great Nation to reflect on the importance of our agricultural heritage"}]}
